name: Wild Harem
source:
You have been selected to participate in a community experiment in a model village. How many friendships and romantic interests can you pursue? Lots of furry characters are waiting for you!

[From [url=https://itoril.itch.io/wildharem]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已被选中参加模范村的社区实验。你可以追求多少友谊和浪漫的兴趣？超多毛茸茸的角色等着你！

[来自[url=https://itoril.itch.io/wildharem]Itch.io[/url]]
